Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: When any of your [Ver.5] trait Digimon would digivolve into this card, for each of their face-down digivolution cards, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with the lowest DP to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
